evals.name: document-authority
evals.prompt: 检查 evals/fixtures/iteration/docs 里的 README 和批准的 spec，结合 runner.js 判断哪些文档主张有冲突或过时、应该修哪一侧。只检查，不改原文件。
evals.expected_output: Correct the current timeout claim, retain approved future retry requirement, separate missing evidence from implementation gaps.
expectations: Identifies README timeout 30 versus implementation constant 10.
Preserves the approved future two-retry requirement and identifies an implementation gap.
Reports retry configurability as unsupported or needing clarification.

evals.name: global-runtime-investigation
evals.prompt: evals/fixtures/iteration/runtime 是一个独立小系统。改重试规则时总要查好几个地方，从实际入口开始调查为什么难改，给证据、可选调整和第一验证点。只调查，不改代码。
evals.expected_output: Trace both entrypoints to task execution, config semantics and tests; compare options with first proof.
expectations: Traces server and worker through execute and retry state.
Identifies divergent config defaults or empty-string semantics.
Inspects test protection and reports its limits.
Provides materially different options and a concrete first verification point.

evals.name: debug-flag
evals.prompt: evals/fixtures/iteration/debug 里关闭重试后仍然重试，observations.md 有观察记录。帮我定位原因，只诊断，不改 retry.js 或其他 fixture。允许隔离本地验证，不使用网络。
evals.expected_output: Demonstrate string false truthiness causing an extra send and preserve diagnose-only scope.
expectations: Runs a local reproduction contrasting unset and string false.
Explains Boolean('false') is true and the second-send causal path.
Separates actual verification from recommended repair.
